description: Accredible provides all the tools you need to learn online; search for courses, manage a to-learn list of courses, get notifications when it’s time to start, find course-mates, and showcase your knowledge on your résumé.

Aclima Inc. delivers environmental intelligence through sensor networks to improve human and planetary health. They use a combination of leading-edge sensor technology, climate science, enterprise software and machine learning to take the pulse of the invisible world around us. Translating real-time data into actionable insights, Aclima is changing the way we understand and manage our communities, cities, and industries.

AdeptID builds AI infrastructure that transforms how talent tools match people to jobs. By connecting with our platform via API, any tool can empower its recruiters or hiring managers to identify all talent, regardless of background. This infrastructure doesn’t just enhance hiring efficiency—it drives a fundamental shift in how the workforce is understood and empowered.

Affect Therapeutics delivers an evidence-based digital care program designed specifically for individuals suffering from stimulant use disorder. The program includes a digital therapeutic smartphone app coupled with telemedicine-based addiction counseling, drug screening, group therapy, and psychiatric support.

Air Protein is a modern food company, crafting the world’s first air meat to feed us sustainably, help renew the planet’s resources, and eliminate compromise between nutrition, taste, and climate impact.
Ajua captures and organizes customer experiences in Africa, providing a better understanding of consumers to drive business growth, and give consumers more options.

Allovue is a planning platform for K-12 schools and school districts that empowers administrators to allocate resources for optimal student support. By integrating with existing financial data systems, the platform helps administrators visualize, analyze, and optimize the impact of spending on outcomes in education. Acquired by PowerSchool

Altro helps users build their credit score fast and for free. By furnishing recurring expenses such as Netflix, Hulu, and Spotify to the US credit bureaus to show evidence of financial stability, they can increase subprime credit scores by as much as 60-120 points in 2 weeks.
AlwaysHired is an immersive sales training program which helps people get jobs at the best technology companies.
AngelList is a community of startups and investors who have streamlined the fund-raising process.

AnswersNow creates innovative technology that allows them to connect their clinical experts with parents of children with autism. Parents use the AnswersNow platform to get on-demand, highly personalized answers to all of their autism-parenting questions.

Applauze is a music ticketing app that helps users find live music, sports, and entertainment events that appeal to their interests. By drawing from primary sellers and ticket sale markets (like StubHub), users can buy tickets and share events with friends.
Apto Payments is a leading-edge, card issuance platform. They help companies issue new cards with fewer constraints and more creativity, for a better cardholder experience.
Allowing migrants to send money to their loved ones in Latin America at reasonable rates.

Asana is a platform that makes it easier for teams to communicate and organize tasks. By centralizing information, they enable users to track, comment, and follow the history of projects, thereby maximizing the potential and efficacy of group work.

Attn: Grace is a female-founded, Certified B Corp.™ disrupting the $26-billion-dollar personal care market for older women. We’ve combined cutting edge technology, sustainable design and powerful, plant-based ingredients with a deep founder-market fit and strategic POV.

Medicaid Migration™ moves low-income employees onto free government-sponsored health insurance. It is an exclusive product of BeneStream™, the company that provides businesses innovative cost-saving products and services by connecting their qualified employees to government benefits.
Binti is helping more children find a family by building software that enables the government to improve the foster care system.
Bit.ly helps users shorten, share, and discover URL links while providing analytical resources for companies to track usage of links and grow their business.
Blavity Inc. is a media company and community focused on Black consumers and media.

BlocPower markets and finances clean energy and energy efficiency projects in financially underserved communities to generate energy bill savings, reduce carbon emissions, provide financial returns to investors, and create employment opportunities for local workers.
Bloom is a consumer health company that offers clinically accurate wearables for mothers to track pregnancy and improve perinatal outcomes.
Bodyport helps heart disease patients stay healthy in their homes through virtual care powered by seamless cardiac monitoring.

BookNook is a web application that syncs up to five devices of any kind so that groups can work together in a coordinated set of rigorous reading exercises. Once online, groups access a library of algorithmically-recommended custom texts that are woven together with a structured curriculum and engaging educational games. BookNook also offers a host of customizable reporting features to provide real-time, actionable information to users and educators.

Breakthrough connects people with mental health providers for online counseling and telepsychiatry. Clients can search for providers on multiple criteria, schedule appointments, and get private, online care.
Bridge aims to provide a path towards upward financial mobility for the millions of people left behind by traditional banking systems.

BrightBee is an online talent marketplace that both empowers workers and enables K-12 schools to fill paraprofessional, classified, and support positions through a unique model based on flexibility, upskilling, and community.

BrightUp is a FinTech startup with a twist – it helps workers and their loved ones grow their net-worth and improve their self-worth. BrightUp believes that how people feel about themselves affects how they treat themselves – particularly when finances are involved. Therefore, BrightUp provides a full suite of financial wellness tools, rooted in a personal wellness-centric experience. BrightUp’s flagship offering is a low-cost emergency loan that is repaid through paycheck deductions.

At BuildCasa we are focused on putting a dent in the housing supply shortage which is one of the biggest challenges we face in America today. Aside from the impacts on climate and inequality, housing is the biggest driver of the inflation holding back our economy with both rents and house prices up 20% YOY.
Captricity transforms static paper documents into electronic, actionable information that can be searched, shared, stored, and studied.

CareCar delivers reliable care and support to at-risk patient populations through supplemental benefit programs and a curated network of experienced caregivers and local organizations. It then leverages and standardizes real-time and retrospective data from each patient encounter to provide actionable insights to payer partners and further improve health outcomes across the country.

Catchafire connects talented individuals with social impact organizations to build capacity in the non-profit sector and provide individuals with meaningful, pro-bono experiences that serves the greater good.

ChargerHelp! operates at the intersection of clean technology and workforce development. Its app-based dispatch and deployment system solves the industry-wide problem of electric vehicle charging station failure by providing on-demand repairs and maintenance support from trained local workforces.

Citizen is the No. 1 public safety app in the U.S. It provides 911 alerts so people can use their phones to keep themselves, and the people and places they love, safe. Citizen has notified people to evacuate burning buildings, deterred school buses from nearby terrorist attacks, and led to the rescue of kidnapped children and missing people. The 911 alerts are accompanied by live stories, real-time updates, and user-generated content so 7M+ app users never have to wonder why there are helicopters overhead or fire engines flying by.

Citrus Lane (acquired by Care.com in 2014) provides monthly care packages that are designed to help moms and dads on their parenting journeys. These packages help parents discover innovative products, share information, ask questions, and find inspiration.

ClassDojo connects millions of teachers, parents and students to help students develop positive behavior and character strengths like persistence, participation, creativity, curiosity, and self-control.
Classkick is a tablet workspace where students work on teacher-made assignments and get immediate help from their instructor and classmates.

Clever is a cloud-based platform that seamlessly integrates student information system (SIS) data with online digital learning tools. It enables teachers to enroll and track students. Using Single Sign On, students can access online resources from different vendors, and teachers can easily log performance among different classes and locations.

CodeHS is a program that teaches computer science to beginners with a focus on high schools. It provides a web-based curriculum, programming environment, teacher tools, and help from real people along the way.
CodeSpark is a high-tech company that is engaged in creating educational software and games for children.

Compology is reinventing the waste industry with a system that monitors the volume of waste inside dumpsters and then uses the data to route collection trucks more efficiently. Accurate, granular waste production data helps collection trucks drive fewer miles and waste producers develop actionable metrics and send less waste to landfills.
Constant Therapy provides research-backed personalized therapy tools for people with traumatic brain injuries, stroke, aphasia, and learning disabilities.

Curve Health is a care enablement platform, focused on creating more treatment-in-place options for vulnerable populations. It seamlessly integrates telemedicine, EHR integration, predictive analytics and smart billing into a single platform. The result is well-orchestrated care that improves healthcare outcomes, greater efficiency and tremendous cost savings. Their clinically peer-reviewed results dramatically reduce unnecessary care escalation, ER visits and re-hospitalizations.
Daivergent is a technology platform that allows companies to fulfill their data requests at scale by matching them to the best-suited workforce: adults with autism.

Daylight is the first and only digital banking platform that is built by the LGBTQ+ community for the LGBTQ+ community. It aims to build a more equitable financial life for LGBT+ folks and their chosen families by helping members navigate the finance system, generate smarter financial habits, find LGBTQ+ businesses, and connect with a peer community who can help them build the life they deserve without compromise.

Desmos changes the way that students explore and understand math. Its blazing-fast graphing calculator works on any computer or tablet — for free. In addition, Desmos’ API makes it possible to incorporate interactive math technology into any platform, assessment, or app.

Devoted Health is a healthcare company for seniors. By launching Medicare Advantage plans, their mission is to build a healthcare solution good enough for the older generation. They help their members navigate the health care system with personal guides, by utilizing world-class technology that enables a simplified experience, and by partnering with top providers for better health outcomes.
DotLab is transforming the diagnosis and management of endometriosis, a disease that affects 1 in 10 women worldwide and currently requires surgery to diagnose.

Driver Technologies uses everyday smartphones to allow couriers to record and navigate their trips while receiving on-the-spot alerts about potential hazards, like jaywalking pedestrians, cars drifting out of their lane, or even drivers falling asleep or not paying attention.

Dropcam is revolutionizing the way people stay connected to the places they care about. It allows you to remotely drop in on your house, baby, pets, business or anything else from a smartphone, tablet or computer.
Earn Up is an Intelligent loan payment automation.

EdCast is a personal learning network that enhances people's ability to collaborate and learn across educational materials, instructors, students and employers. EdCast Knowledge Cloud™ powers online learning portals built on OpenedX for world class institutions, enterprises, governments and non-profits, enabling millions of students to collaborate with each other and learn.

eddii is a virtual in-app character designed to engage people with living with diabetes to manage their health. It connects real-time to a user’s Continuous Glucose Monitor (CGM). Through education, gamification, and witty conversation, eddii becomes a virtual health buddy, providing users with real-time feedback, support, and in-app rewards.

Elation Health is an intuitive, easy-to-use SaaS platform that sits at the heart of the patient-physician relationship. It makes it easy for doctors to quickly act upon clinical information and provide comprehensive, personalized, proactive care to patients.
Elevate is an award-winning brain training tool designed to build communication and analytical skills.
Encantos is a leading family entertainment and education company that builds consumer brands for today’s multicultural world.

Endaga empowers anyone, anywhere to build and operate their own cellular networks. The technology is the first to enable independent, small-scale and profitable cellular networks, even in the most remote and sparsely populated areas on earth. Endaga tech reduces the capital and operational costs of rural cellular networks by multiple orders of magnitude, and its cloud-based management, interconnect, and automation services make being a cellular network operator as simple as plugging in a WiFi router.

Engrade is an education technology platform that has an integration-friendly architecture that enables data from multiple external sources to merge together seamlessly. It is accessible via web, mobile, and tablet devices.
Enuma® creates exceptional learning tools that allow all children to gain confidence and independence while building foundational skills.
Ethic uses technology, data-science and design to accelerate the global transition to sustainable investing.

Fidelis is a Learning Relationship Management Software Company. It takes a 360 degree view of learning, combining mentorship, coursework, supplementary learning, job placement and coaching into a coherent educational experience that is based on the personal goals of the student.
Flowtown is a social media marketing platform that helps businesses transform email contacts into engaged customers.
Form Energy is developing a new class of cost-effective, multi-day energy storage systems that will enable a reliable and fully-renewable electric grid year-round.

Formation is an adaptive learning training platform for software engineers. Our platform uses a patented AI algorithm (USA No. 11,551,321) to dynamically adapt the curriculum to each student in realtime. We have a focus on engineers from underrepresented groups, with over 20% of our students identifying as Black.
Formlabs is developing an affordable high-resolution 3D printer that will enable designers, engineers, and makers to easily realize their dreams in beautiful physical form.

FounderDating is the premiere online network for entrepreneurs. It connects cofounders, enabling talented individuals to find people with complementary skill sets to launch their next company or project.

Freckle's mission is to ensure every student gets a world-class education. As the first and only Differentiation Platform, Freckle empowers more than 500,000 teachers to reach all of their students at the level that is perfect for them across Math, ELA, Social Studies and Science!

Fundly believes anyone can raise money for the people, projects, causes and communities they care about. It is transforming how individuals and organizations crowdfund to improve the communities in which they live. They help stories come to life on any device and make it effortless to share with friends, colleagues and social networks.
FutureAdvisor is an online investment advisor that automatically manages investments to help people do better with their money. FutureAdvisor works with existing investments including 401(k)s.

Gengo is the translation service behind global companies like YouTube and TripAdvisor. Using thousands of qualified translators from around the world, it enables companies to reach global audiences by providing fast, affordable, high-quality translation services.
Get Satisfaction is a leading customer engagement platform, that enables organizations to build better relationships with their customers through conversation and feedback.

Ginger Health believes that everyone deserves access to incredible mental healthcare. Ginger’s on-demand system brings together a team of behavioral health coaches, therapists, and psychiatrists, who deliver personalized care, through a smartphone. The Ginger app provides members with access to the support they need within seconds, 24/7, 365 days a year. Millions of people have access to Ginger through leading employers, health plans and partners. Ginger has been recognized by The World Economic Forum as a Technology Pioneer and by Fast Company as one of the Most Innovative Companies in Healthcare.

Good Eggs is a grocery delivery service that makes fresh, organic groceries accessible to everyone. The process is simple. After ordering online from the best local farmers & foodmakers, the groceries are picked, prepped to order and delivered.

GroupRaise is a marketplace and booking engine that helps restaurants host large groups of customers, typically 20-200+, during under-utilized times, in exchange for donating a % of sales to a charitable cause.
Gusto is a reimagining payroll, benefits, HR, and healthcare for modern small- and medium-sized businesses. It serves 140,000 businesses nationwide, and process tens of billions of payroll each year.
At Hamlet, our mission is to improve American cities by transforming public data into clearer, more understandable insights.

Handle Financial is an electronic cash-transaction network that enables consumers to pay rent and utility bills, repay loans, buy tickets, make online purchases and do much more with cash. Consumers conveniently pay at over 17,000 stores including 7-Eleven, Family Dollar and ACE Cash Express.
Healthify is a leading software solution for healthcare and community services that addresses social determinants of health by working collaboratively.

HealthLoop is a cloud-based platform that automates follow-up care; keeping doctors, patients and caregivers connected between visits with clinical information that is insightful, actionable, and engaging. Their peer-reviewed follow-up plans automate the routine aspects of care while tracking patient progress and monitoring clinical areas of concern.
The Health Sherpa is a free guide that makes it easier to find and sign up for health insurance under the Affordable Care Act. It only uses carefully vetted, publicly available data.
High Fidelity is a tech-startup that works on “big ideas,” harnessing the collective computing power in user devices to build a new kind of virtual world.
High Fidelity is a tech-startup that works on “big ideas,” harnessing the collective computing power in user devices to build a new kind of virtual world.
Homeroom’s mission is to build a trusted brand that supports parents in managing their child’s care and enrichment, through seamless booking and discovery.
Honor is an online service that connects in-home caregivers, seniors, and their families.
Human Dx enables and supports the development of the Human Diagnosis Project, a global open medical project that maps any human health problem to its possible diagnosis.

Hustle is a peer-to-peer text messaging platform that provides organizations across the country with an affordable, efficient, and effective tool that allows them to reach their target supporters and customers. By facilitating two-way conversations, Hustle’s users can maintain genuine, personal dialogues with hundreds, thousands, and even millions of people.
Indi is the first inclusive people automation platform that democratizes internal opportunity and networking.

inDinero creates software to help small businesses better track and manage their finances. It aims to provide its users with instant insights into the finances of their companies, leading them to save on unnecessary expenses and earn more money for their companies.

The world’s first end-to-end platform for mobile learning content, Inkling makes it easy to bring rich, interactive learning content to tablet devices. It engages students and provides authors and publishers with an exciting new way to bring information to the market.
Intake AI builds AI-native data infrastructure for clinical trials. They deploy AI agents at clinical research sites to automate the data workflows that run every trial.
interviewing.io helps engineers get hired based on their skills, not how they look on paper.
Jopwell helps Black, Latino/Hispanic, and Native American candidates connect with companies.

Kai XR is an inclusive and accessible 360˚/VR platform that allows kids to immerse themselves in new worlds and opportunities, through their smartphones. They can explore diverse virtual field trips and dream and create their very own virtual adventures.
Kairos solves the problem of identity through a facial recognition API. Anyone can build, launch and scale their facial recognition apps and services with just a few lines of code.

King of the Curve is an educational technology company designed to help students score top marks on rigorous standardized exams while simultaneously making studying fun and accessible. Their platform ensures that each student has the support they need to achieve their educational and career goals, ultimately turning student stress into student success.

Kinly is a digitally native neobank that is building generational wealth for Black America. Though unbanked, underbanked and underserved, the Black community’s $1.4-trillion in annual economic impact provides a significant base to build upon. By providing a platform that is focused on improving financial livelihood through incentive-based financial education, Black-focused spending and automated wealth building, Kinly takes the stress out of managing money for members while also helping them develop positive financial behaviors and habits that allow them to reach their goals faster.

LawChamps allows individuals to buy fixed-price a-la-carte legal services from independent local lawyers. Once matched, it allows individuals and lawyers to communicate and make payments through the platform. Individuals can also finance their a-la-carte legal services.
LeadGenius helps companies replace their sales support staff with a combination of artificial intelligence, the world’s biggest database of leads, and a fairly-paid virtual workforce.

Lendstreet has partnerships within the financial sector that allow it to negotiate discounts on debts. This means it can pass on the discount to its customers who, in turn, can get out of debt sooner, rebuild their credit, and get on with their lives.

Life360 is a communication and location-sharing platform that keeps millions of families connected, no matter what life throws their way. With over 33 million registered families, it is the biggest family network in the world.

LiquiDonate Inc. enables retailers and brands to appropriately disposition their unsellable returns and overstock inventory, instead of landfilling them, to save retailers at least 50% on reverse logistics.

Lirvana Labs Inc is an app-based platform utilising machine learning to curate safe and effective multi-media content and literature that boosts Social Emotional Learning, English Literacy, and Math Reasoning skills in early childhood and elementary years.
Livestar is a mobile app that instantly provides users with movie, music, app, restaurant and other recommendations from critics and friends.

Looksharp’s platform connects students with opportunities at companies that are looking to hire. It also gives companies the opportunity to build their brand on college campuses and expand their reach to more student talent.
Loris helps the world’s fastest-growing companies engage in in better customer care conversations by text.

Love With Food is a marketing platform that collects product intelligence data for consumer food brands. It helps brands send out samples in monthly snack boxes. A meal is donated to food banks nationwide with every box sent.
Lumi is democratizing storytelling and unlocking the innate storyteller in everyone. They provide generative AI tools to enable independent story creation, distribution, and merchandising.
Magoosh creates web and mobile applications with expert content and video tutorials to help students prepare for standardized tests such as the GRE, GMAT, and SAT.

Make School is building a 2-year university replacement that teaches software engineering, and computer science theory to better prepares students for a career as a software developer or startup founder. Their emphasis is on building real-world products and equipping students with the technical skills and professional network they need to build a successful career in tech. Students have no out-of-pocket cost for the program, they pay tuition through earnings during and after the program with no risk and no debt.

Malaica makes the pregnancy journey safe and joyful for African mothers. The program includes a number of proven interventions delivered by a dedicated nurse-midwife and is driven by a team of doctors, midwives, engineers and serial entrepreneurs.
Managed by Q is a platform that makes the office management process more efficient.

Maro’s digital “medical neighborhood” operates across home, school and clinic to support early intervention & risk detection starting with school-based mental health screening and triaged interventions.
Mercaris is a market data service and online trading platform for organic, non-GMO, and certified agricultural commodities.

Modria is the world’s leading conflict resolution platform, creating software that enables companies to quickly and comprehensively address customer service issues. It increases customer loyalty and retention while lowering support costs for businesses.
Motion Math’s makes fun learning games for the toughest concepts of elementary school math. Their mission is to help kids find delight in intellectual challenges.

Mytonomy is a near-peer social network designed to bring alumni advice to high school students and support the overburdened high school counselor. They help young people from the age of 14–25 make better decisions about big life choices: how to go to college and pay for it, where to apply, what to study, and how to link all of that to an eventual career.

Nadia Care improves outcomes by reimagining how maternity and pediatric care is delivered in Medicaid, lower-income, and other communities. Nadia Care uses a multidisciplinary care team to provide technology-enabled, maternity support services. The care model reduces the barriers between patients recommended care, improving outcomes for mom and baby.
Newsela is an instructional content platform that supercharges reading engagement and learning in every subject.

NoRedInk.com is an online learning platform that helps students improve their grammar/writing skills. Their engine creates exercises from personal interests, adapts to learners’ strengths and weaknesses, and generates color-coded heat maps that help students, teachers, schools, and districts track improvement.

NovoEd is the only online learning platform that uses a combination of techniques in crowdsourcing, design and analysis of reputation systems, and algorithm design to provide a connected, effective and engaging learning environment for students.

Numerade is focused on creating exceptional video and interactive content experiences for education, making the knowledge and skills of world-class educators widely accessible and affordable to student audiences of all backgrounds. Their mission is to close the educational opportunity gap by unlocking and democratizing access to extraordinary educators and the content they offer.
Omada Health is a digital healthcare company that focuses on preventable, chronic diseases.

Optimizely is a web-optimization platform that helps companies conceive and run data-driven testing, enabling them to make dynamic changes to their websites, control traffic, gather immediate results, and achieve their goals. Optimizely's growing customer base includes Starbucks, eBay, and Disney.
Orchestra is the creator of Mailbox, an app that organizes and sends emails. It was acquired by Dropbox in 2013.

Oula is a modern maternity center that combines the best of obstetrics and midwifery care to offer women an evidence-based and personalized pregnancy experience that includes collaborative, safe, and less-medicalized care during pregnancy. Through tech-enabled maternity clinics, it combines the safety and continuity of care offered at an OB practice with the collaborative approach of midwives.

OutRival empowers customer experience teams to innovate with AI, enabling them to create and deploy AI solutions that fuel growth, enhance customer experiences, and reimagine business potential. We exist to bridge the gap between customer insight and AI execution, making innovation accessible to everyone.
PadSplit is a marketplace for privatized affordable housing. They offer all-inclusive, shared homes that empower everyday Americans to build savings, chase their dreams, and change their world.
Pair Team is focused on innovatively addressing the healthcare needs of the most vulnerable and complex populations.
Paloma Learning delivers a mobile web app that enables daily 15‑minute parent‑led tutoring in reading and math.

Parento is revolutionizing the way companies offer paid parental leave by introducing the first and only private-sector insurance for it. In a competitive labor market, paid leave is one of the top most-requested employee benefits, yet many organizations—ranging from small businesses to large unions—struggle with its complexity, cost, and uncertain ROI.
Peel builds innovative experiences that enhance the TV experience, including a seamless remote control, delightful program discovery, personalized recommendations, and engaging social interactions.

Penny Finance is the first personalized and tech-powered financial mentor for women who don’t have access to a financial advisor - and crave easy, digestible financial education and know-how to increase cash flow today, and retire with wealth tomorrow.
Pigeonly collects and organizes data on the nation’s incarcerated. It transforms this data it into usable information that can be used to power products that benefit inmates and society.

Planet FWD is on a mission to help undo climate change by making it easier to bring climate-friendly food products to market. By creating a regenerative ingredient database, we are hoping to connect farmers who are helping to bury carbon in the soil with consumers who are hungry to take action on climate change. They have also created the first totally climate-friendly snack brand.
Posterous is making blogging as simple as sending an email by helping people share selectively across multiple platforms with intuitive privacy controls. The company was acquired by Twitter in 2011.

Promise is a modern payment platform that works with government agencies and related organizations that collect anything from utility bills to license fees. It provides flexibility in payments for people who can’t cover their whole water or electricity bill at once.

Propeller is a digital therapeutic designed to help patients and their physicians better understand and control asthma, COPD, and other respiratory diseases. With a unique combination of sensors, mobile apps, and analytics, the system encourages adherence to maintenance therapy and remotely monitors use of rescue medications allowing for early intervention, which helps reduce preventable emergency room visits, hospitalizations, unnecessary suffering and avoid costly exacerbations.
ProSky gives companies the ability to innovatively evaluate candidates and develop employees through succession pathways. Users can recruit, hire, and retain the best diverse talent and culture fit.
Puzzle is an Integrated financial software designed for founders and finance teams.

R3 Score is a prison reentry software solution company delivering two complementary solutions: R3Up - a job and reentry readiness prison tablet app and R3 Report - a more holistic criminal background check report.

Rain equips fire agencies to deploy "fire sprinklers for the forest" - early wildfire detection integrated with autonomous helicopters per-positioned throughout high wildfire risk areas to rapidly contain ignitions before they grow out of control.

Red Rabbit is an NYC-based healthy school meal provider to the New York metro area. Our child-tested and approved menu offerings, farm-fresh and locally sourced food, educational programs and easy-to-implement delivery system programs make it a favorite for schools, educators, and parents.

Reportwell is a compliance and reporting platform transforming how government agencies manage regulatory compliance. From collecting highly complex regulatory filings to providing enterprises with state-specific legal insights, Reportwell streamlines regulatory processes across sectors.
Revivn is a hardware lifecycle management platform that helps companies repurpose their unused hardware for underserved communities.

Ribbon Education strives to deliver better student outcomes by enabling greater learner-school relationships. It provides a single hub for all learner signals, communications, and collaborative notes for scaled online adult education schools.

Safer Management sells attendance, behavioral, and curriculum software to public school districts and colleges. Public schools receive federal funding based on their average daily attendance and standardize test scores. They use machine learning and artificial intelligence algorithms to create proprietary software features that schools use to track student attendance and improve standardized test scores. Their software ensures schools get the adequate funding they need to educate the future leaders of the world.

Saltbox is building modern co-warehousing communities for the millions of entrepreneurs that operate in the world of physical commerce and need things such as concrete floors, pallet jacks, and loading docks, but don’t want to surrender their expectations of modern flexibility, comfort, and convenience. They provide highly functional micro-warehousing facilities complemented by traditional co-working and community spaces that members can feel proud to call home.

Our 360° model of care enhances the gold standard of medication adherence, Directly Observed Therapy. Combining personalized video coaching, education, and motivational content, we bring healthcare professionals, patients, and their families together to solve the $500B medication nonadherence problem. Our mobile app allows patients to connect with a care team of pharmacists, nurses, and health coaches through daily video check-ins, anytime and anywhere. We make it fun for patients to stay on top of their medications, help them address any medication challenges, and empower them to improve their health by identifying and addressing barriers to adherence related to social determinants of health. Over 120 customers across the healthcare landscape use our medication engagement program to improve medication adherence for patients with chronic and infectious diseases.

SchoolMint provides a cloud-based student enrollment and school choice platform to PreK-12 school systems worldwide. Since its founding in 2013, close to 4000 schools have chosen SchoolMint to streamline all aspects of student enrollment – student registration management, application, lottery, and school choice management, and digital forms and document uploads. Available online and on mobile devices, SchoolMint integrates with leading student information systems (SIS) and transforms the end-to-end enrollment experience for school staff and parents.

Schoolzilla delivers timely, actionable insights to teachers, principals, and district leaders through a SaaS data and business intelligence platform. By merging data from dozens of different sources such as attendance, test scores, online learning tools, human resources and financial accounting, Schoolzilla empowers educators to make smarter, faster decisions to increase student achievement.

Searchlight is a full-cycle talent platform that uses science to help companies hire more top performers and diverse teams, by winning talent in today’s competitive market. Their best-in-class Reference product gives teams predictive data on competencies, working styles, and areas of growth. The full platform integrates their data across the hiring process to better align recruiters and hiring managers, assess candidates objectively, and provide information that helps companies hire better.

SeedFi is a financial health startup that helps Americans build credit, save money, access funds, and plan for the future. Created by founders with years of fintech experience and firsthand knowledge of common money pain points, SeedFi’s mission is to help Americans break the cycle of debt and realize their financial potential.
Selected is a platform that matches teachers with schools they love by streamlining the job search and hiring process.

SendHub enhances business communication by providing companies with free and low-cost telecommunication options. With SendHub, colleagues receive free phone numbers in any area code accessible on any device, simplifying communication and providing instant analytics with a single click.

Shifted Energy is clean technology startup working to enable the transition to a fully renewable grid through a distributed energy aggregation software platform. We use machine learning, data analytics, and smart controls.

Simple HealthKit (SHK) is healthcare from anywhere. Re-built for everyone. We build affordable, accessible and accurate end-to-end diagnostic and digital health solutions. Because world-class care for everyone means better health for all.

Sivil is a public safety software company with a mission of creating a safer world for everyone. Their goal is to help cities and counties make data-driven decisions that increase transparency of police conduct, decrease taxpayer money spent on use of force claims, and improve the relationship between police and the community.
Socialize is a drop-in social platform that creates a community around apps, leveraging networking features through a single interface. It was acquired by ShareThis in 2013.

Stretch is reimagining grocery shopping. As shoppers seek smarter ways to manage their grocery spending, our platform creates unprecedented opportunities for retailers and brands to understand behavior, refine strategy, and uncover new opportunities as households evolve their shopping habits to make every dollar count. Our platform provides new opportunities for retailers and brands to understand behavior, refine strategy, and uncover growth as shoppers seek smarter ways to manage their grocery spending.

Strive helps high potential, low credential candidates land the middle-class careers they desire and deserve. Strive’s hiring platform helps companies source and evaluate candidates based on competencies and potential rather than credentials and pedigree.

StyleSeek is a personalized style discovery site that enables users to establish their own unique Style DNA. They can find inspiration for their style, browse and shop for items, and receive sophisticated recommendations based on their specific preferences.

SV Academy is a workforce accelerator that provides millions of non-traditional job seekers, who lack prior industry work experience or insider connections, with direct access to a career in tech sales. No coding experience is required.
Sweep is a platform that allows users to plan ahead for bills, expenses, and savings goals by providing a complete forward-looking view of their cash flow.
Swing Education is an online system for educators that helps prevent interruptions in the classroom by matching substitute teachers with schools.
Talko is an app designed to unlock the potential of voice. It allows people to use their voice to increase communication and social productivity.

TasteBud is a product discovery platform. We leverage AI to get to know your family — preferences, dietary restrictions, what works and what doesn't — and send you perfectly matched products from premium brands. For free.
tEQuitable is an independent, confidential platform that helps users address issues of bias, discrimination and harassment in the workplace.

Thalamus is a premier, cloud-based interview management platform designed specifically for application to Graduate Medical Education (GME) training programs. The platform integrates with existing application systems to assist both applicants and administrators streamline their processes and conduct virtual interviews.

Thrive Market is an online wholesale buying club that aims to make healthy living easy and affordable for every American family. It currently offers 4,000 of the most popular natural and organic products at 25-50 percent off the retail price. These products can be shipped anywhere in the U.S for free. The company also gives a free membership to a low-income family, veteran, or teacher, for every paid member on the site.

Tinybop is a studio of designers, developers, and artists who are building a suite of educational iOS apps for kids. They believe in the power of learning through play, experimentation, and inquiry, and strive to create immersive games that encourage exploration and creativity.

TomoCredit offers credit cards to Americans who are cash-rich but have been overlooked by traditional lenders because they have no credit score. It was founded by a team of immigrants from MIT and UC Berkeley who were determined to build a better credit system. TomoCredit’s proprietary underwriting technology identifies and offers credit cards to users based on real-time cash flow behavior.

True Link is a fraud protection service for the 11 million at-risk seniors who lose a total of $52 billion per year. Their specialized Visa card automatically blocks unwanted charges, protecting seniors’ money and enabling them to live happily and independently for longer.
Twilio allows software developers to programmatically make and receive phone calls, and send and receive text messages using its web service APIs.

Uber captures the elite limo experience and transforms it into an on-demand service that fits an efficient and modern lifestyle. Uber provides a seamless experience on mobile to book and pay for your on-demand car service.

Uncharted is a Platform as a Service (PaaS) company that helps cities and developers reduce the cost and complexity of deploying and managing last-mile infrastructure. Founded in 2011 and headquartered in New York, Uncharted is an award-winning, MWBE-certified company focused on the mission to accelerate the equitable development of smart, sustainable infrastructure worldwide.

UpLift delivers collaborative psychotherapy and psychiatry tightly integrated with local providers to drive value for patients, providers, and payers at meaningful scale. We're rebuilding the behavioral healthcare delivery system to thrive under current fee-for-service payment models, and are driving the market towards value-based care.

Vault is an employment benefit platform that helps companies hire and retain employees for longer by saving them thousands of dollars. They help employees by in paying down their student loans, contributing to 529 plans, providing tuition reimbursement and more.

Velano Vascular‘s technologies transform care by reducing the stress and anxiety related to drawing blood during hospitalization. The company’s vascular access devices aim to reduce pain and discomfort for patients, while enhancing safety and efficiency for providers. The company’s collaborators include leading U.S. hospital systems and cutting-edge patient care organizations.
Verificient Technologies provides scalable continuous identity verification solutions through its patent-pending application ProctorTrack.

Via is a revolutionary technology platform that is changing the way people move around cities. Via's phone app offers users a ride that costs a little more than the bus. It’s on-demand transportation on a mass scale that’s friendly to our planet.

Visual.ly makes it possible to present information in a bite-sized visual way that makes sense for the age of big data. Their platform democratizes the creation and sharing of visualizations, making it possible for everyone to participate.

WePow’s scalable and customizable video and mobile recruitment solutions simplify talent acquisition. Their innovative clients are increasing productivity and efficiency, and significantly reducing interviewing costs while improving the quality of their engagement with candidates.

WorkAmerica unites education and employment by building job guaranteed pathways for vocational education students at community colleges. They help de-risking students’ enrollment decisions while solving the skill gap that plagues America’s employers.

Worklete is an advanced technology for frontline teams that reduces injuries, costs and inefficiencies using predictive analytics and smart skill-building. It also provides visibility and connectivity to the frontline workforce.

WriteLab is a web-based software that gives students immediate feedback on any piece of writing. It blends data-driven analysis with proven pedagogical principles to address many areas in revision, such as clarity, concision, cohesion, and logic.
Yobongo is a mobile communication startup that enables users to chat based on location, real-time and identity. Yobongo was acquired by Mixbook in 2012.

Zing Health Choice IL (HMO) is a Medicare Advantage plan serving Medicare-eligible beneficiaries. They take the time to get to know you and partner with you to develop a plan that meets your health needs and goals.

Zoobean’s SaaS platform, mobile app, and reading logs help organizations and families read more and read together. The company’s Beanstack product is the #1 solution for managing public libraries’ reading challenges and is licensed by over 1,500 schools to motivate students to read independently. For consumers, the Beanstack app is often likened to a Fitbit for Reading.
